name: pursuit_violins_long
character: The tension bed: high sustained violins that grow by adding players and swell on the bow, wide behind the listener on the right (its players are detuned by 3 cents only: at 10 cents the six beat against each other near 10 Hz and the stem gate read a tick, measured on the first two renders).
